description: Ryu's first-party capability taxonomy. A capability is a job an agent wants done; a platform is the real-world system the job acts on. An endpoint joins one capability on one platform, and (platform, capability) is the comparison row that lines up vendors serving the same job. Promoted capabilities whose `verbs` are listed are the canonical facade verbs in apps/core/src/sidecar/mcp/capability_tools.rs (one capability per verb; `layer` is the binding capability that serves it). New jobs land as `proposed` and are promoted by review; a capability with comparison `per_model` (generative media) compares only endpoints that run the same model. Read by ryu_gw_contracts::capability_taxonomy and @ryuhq/protocol/capability-taxonomy.

platforms.name: Public web
platforms.description: Pages and search results on the open internet.

platforms.name: Browser session
platforms.description: A live browser tab, local Chromium or a cloud browser, driven on the user's behalf.

platforms.name: Desktop computer
platforms.description: The user's own screen, keyboard and pointer.

platforms.name: Agent memory store
platforms.description: Long-term facts an agent remembers across conversations.

platforms.name: Typed decision model
platforms.description: A model that answers choice, score or yes/no questions with structured output.

platforms.name: Source of truth
platforms.description: A reference document set or rule base that claims are checked against.

platforms.name: Generative media model
platforms.description: Hosted image and video generation models.

capabilities.name: Answer a typed question about a state
capabilities.description: Answer choice, score or yes/no questions about a text or JSON state with structured output.

capabilities.name: Answer a typed question about images
capabilities.description: Answer typed questions about a text or JSON state that includes embedded images.

capabilities.name: Check a claim
capabilities.description: Check a plain-language claim against a source of truth and return a verdict with its evidence.

capabilities.name: List checkable sources
capabilities.description: List the sources of truth that claims can be checked against.

capabilities.name: Search the web
capabilities.description: Return ranked web results (title, URL, snippet) for a query.

capabilities.name: Extract a page
capabilities.description: Return the readable content of one web page.

capabilities.name: Crawl a site
capabilities.description: Follow links from a start URL and return the extracted pages.

capabilities.name: Open a URL in a browser
capabilities.description: Open a URL in a real browser tab and return the resulting tab.

capabilities.name: Read the page accessibility tree
capabilities.description: Return the page's accessibility tree with stable element references.

capabilities.name: Click a page element
capabilities.description: Click an element identified by an accessibility reference.

capabilities.name: Type into a page element
capabilities.description: Insert text into an element identified by an accessibility reference.

capabilities.name: Scroll the page
capabilities.description: Scroll a browser page in a direction.

capabilities.name: Screenshot the page
capabilities.description: Capture an image of the current browser page.

capabilities.name: List browser tabs
capabilities.description: List open browser tabs with their ids, URLs and titles.

capabilities.name: Gather page context
capabilities.description: Return the page screenshot, accessibility snapshot, saved annotations and pointed-element DOM context together.

capabilities.name: Annotate a page region
capabilities.description: Attach a frozen-frame visual comment to page elements or an area.

capabilities.name: Clear page annotations
capabilities.description: Remove saved visual comments from a browser tab.

capabilities.name: Hover over a page element
capabilities.description: Move the pointer over an element without clicking it.

capabilities.name: Click a page coordinate
capabilities.description: Click a viewport coordinate where no accessibility reference exists.

capabilities.name: Press a key in the page
capabilities.description: Press a key or key chord at the page's current focus.

capabilities.name: Drag between page coordinates
capabilities.description: Drag the pointer between two viewport coordinates.

capabilities.name: Capture the screen
capabilities.description: Capture the screen with accessibility metadata for later targeting.

capabilities.name: Click a screen coordinate
capabilities.description: Click at a coordinate on the desktop.

capabilities.name: Type text at the keyboard focus
capabilities.description: Type text into whatever has desktop keyboard focus.

capabilities.name: Press a key on the desktop
capabilities.description: Press a key or key chord at the desktop's keyboard focus.

capabilities.name: Scroll at a screen coordinate
capabilities.description: Scroll the desktop at a given coordinate.

capabilities.name: Bring an application forward
capabilities.description: Bring a desktop application to the front before interacting with it.

capabilities.name: Recall remembered facts
capabilities.description: Recall durable facts from long-term memory for a query.

capabilities.name: Remember a fact
capabilities.description: Store a durable fact at an agent, user, node, project or org scope.

capabilities.name: Summarise what memory knows
capabilities.description: Return a short standing summary of what the memory provider knows.

capabilities.name: Feed a conversation turn to memory
capabilities.description: Hand a raw conversation turn to the memory provider and let it extract what to keep.

capabilities.name: Forget a remembered fact
capabilities.description: Delete a remembered fact by id.

capabilities.name: Identify the connected account
capabilities.description: Return the profile of the account a connection acts as.

capabilities.name: List repositories
capabilities.description: List the code repositories the connected account can access.

capabilities.name: List a project's issues
capabilities.description: List the issues filed against one repository or project.

capabilities.name: List issues assigned to me
capabilities.description: List the issues assigned to the connected account across projects.

capabilities.name: Read an issue
capabilities.description: Return one issue by its number or id.

capabilities.name: File an issue
capabilities.description: Open a new issue with a title and body.

capabilities.name: Comment on an issue
capabilities.description: Add a comment to an existing issue.

capabilities.name: Search issues and pull requests
capabilities.description: Find issues and pull requests matching a query.

capabilities.name: Generate an image
capabilities.description: Produce an image from a text prompt with a named model.

capabilities.name: Generate a video
capabilities.description: Produce a video clip from a text or image prompt with a named model.
